import * as spar from "../sdk/index.js";

export interface BuildPlanRequest {
  readonly connection: string;
  readonly table: string;
  readonly force: boolean;
}

export type LookupError =
  | { readonly code: "discontinued"; readonly sku: string; readonly replacement: string | null }
  | { readonly code: "notFound"; readonly sku: string };

export interface Plan {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly steps: readonly PlanStep[];
  readonly budget: Money | null;
  readonly version: number | null;
}

export type PlanError =
  | { readonly code: "connectionNotFound"; readonly connectionId: string }
  | { readonly code: "forbidden" }
  | { readonly code: "tableMissing"; readonly connection: string; readonly table: string };

export interface PlanItem {
  readonly label: string;
  readonly weight: number;
}

export interface PlanStep {
  readonly order: number;
  readonly title: string;
}

export const planning = {
  get: (request: string, options?: spar.CallOptions): Promise<Plan> =>
    spar.invoke<Plan>("planning", "get", request, options),
  count: (options?: spar.CallOptions): Promise<number> =>
    spar.invoke<number>("planning", "count", undefined, options),
  build: (request: BuildPlanRequest, options?: spar.CallOptions): Promise<spar.Result<Plan, PlanError>> =>
    spar.invoke<spar.Result<Plan, PlanError>>("planning", "build", request, options),
  steps: (request: number, options?: spar.CallOptions): AsyncIterable<PlanStep> =>
    spar.stream<PlanStep>("planning", "steps", request, options),
  total: (request: string, options?: spar.CallOptions): Promise<Money> =>
    spar.invoke<Money>("planning", "total", request, options),
  lookup: (request: string, options?: spar.CallOptions): Promise<spar.Result<Item, LookupError>> =>
    spar.invoke<spar.Result<Item, LookupError>>("planning", "lookup", request, options),
  items: (options?: spar.CallOptions): Promise<readonly PlanItem[]> =>
    spar.invoke<readonly PlanItem[]>("planning", "items", undefined, options),
} as const;

==== TS packages/@spar/sdk/index.ts
// Generated by Spar. Do not edit.
export interface CallOptions {
  readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
}

/** A command's outcome when it declares expected errors. */
export type Result<T, E> =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: T }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: E };

export interface Transport {
  invoke(contract: string, command: string, request: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<unknown>;
  stream(contract: string, command: string, request: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal): AsyncIterable<unknown>;
}

let transport: Transport | undefined;

export function configureTransport(value: Transport): void {
  transport = value;
}

function current(): Transport {
  if (transport === undefined) {
    throw new Error("No Spar transport is configured.");
  }

  return transport;
}

export function invoke<T>(contract: string, command: string, request: unknown, options?: CallOptions): Promise<T> {
  return current().invoke(contract, command, request, options?.signal) as Promise<T>;
}

export function stream<T>(contract: string, command: string, request: unknown, options?: CallOptions): AsyncIterable<T> {
  return current().stream(contract, command, request, options?.signal) as AsyncIterable<T>;
}
